subject: Browser is not able to connect to the Shiny server

messages.author: 4dce7ac8c4d4567d
messages.subject: Browser is not able to connect to the Shiny server
parts:
Hi,

I have successfully installed the shiny server, but browser is not able to connect to the shiny server.  I am pointing it to the http://<hostname>:3838/MY-APP/.
Also i have run the command shiny::runApp('FolderName') by setting the path to working directory, it is listening on port 8100, but it is giving "no display specified" error and hence not able to connect to the browser.
Is this due to the port issue? Can anyone please suggest solution for the same.

Thanks in advance,
Tushar

messages.author: 4dce7ac8c4d4567d
messages.subject: Re: Browser is not able to connect to the Shiny server
parts:
I am able to connect to http://<hostname>:8100/ and it is showing risk indicator sensitivity default graph, but i am not able to access the example from my local folder http://<hostname>:8100/root/rdownload/R_Shiny/R-3.0.0/bin/exec/shiny/inst/examples/03_reactivity.shiny.  
Also when i am running the command shiny::runApp('FolderName') from R by setting the path to working directory to execute the Server.R file of folder, it is listening on port 8100, but it is giving "no display specified" error and after sometime i am getting ERROR: [on_request_read] connection reset by peer.

Port 8100 is working fine for me, but i am not able to run my actual application. Could anyone please suggest me the solution for the same.

Thanks in advance,
Tushar
